marketing.title: Grade10 — graded cards, bought and sold in one place
marketing.description: Buy graded slabs outright from the Grade10 store, or bid on the ones that only come up once. One account carries your profile, your orders, and your bids.

store.title: Marketplace — Grade10
store.description: Sealed boxes, singles and graded slabs, priced and ready to ship. Start from a collection, or bid on the cards that only come up once.

storeCollections.title: All collections — Grade10
storeCollections.description: Graded slabs at a fixed price, each listed with its grade. Browse every collection the Grade10 store carries and check out when you are ready.

auction.title: Auctions — Grade10
auction.description: Every published Grade10 sale and the lots under it, with the top bid on each. Browsing needs no account; bidding does.

terms.title: Terms of Service — Grade10
terms.description: The terms you agree to when you buy, bid, grade or vault a card with Grade10.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Grade10
privacy.description: What Grade10 records about a collector, why it is kept, and what a collector can ask for it.

book.title: Book a visit — Grade10
book.description: Pick a service, a shop and a time to bring a card in. No account needed.

bookManage.title: Your visit — Grade10
bookManage.description: See, move or cancel a visit you booked with Grade10.

bookMine.title: Your visits — Grade10
bookMine.description: Every visit booked with Grade10 under your email address.
